content.user_title: Review WooCommerce code against project standards
content.value_statement: WooCommerce changes can violate project-specific architecture, testing, documentation, and copy rules. This skill structures reviews around those standards and returns cited, actionable fixes.
actual_capabilities: Reviews WooCommerce PHP changes for architecture and dependency injection conventions.
Checks PHP naming, documentation, data integrity, and unit test conventions.
Flags frontend barrel self-imports that can create circular dependencies.
Reviews WooCommerce interface text for sentence case.
Formats findings with locations, referenced standards, and suggested fixes.
limitations: Requires companion WooCommerce skills for complete standards and examples.
Does not run tests, linters, static analyzers, or repository commands.
Does not provide an exhaustive security, performance, or accessibility review.
Review accuracy depends on receiving the relevant code changes and file context.

use_cases.title: Check a local change
use_cases.description: Review a WooCommerce patch before submission and identify project-specific convention violations.

use_cases.title: Prepare pull request feedback
use_cases.description: Generate structured comments with locations, standards, and concise correction guidance.

use_cases.title: Audit cross-stack changes
use_cases.description: Check PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, tests, and interface copy within one review.

prompt_templates.title: Quick standards check
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this WooCommerce change for the listed standards. Report each issue with its location, standard, and suggested fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a small change or first review.

prompt_templates.title: Review PHP changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these PHP changes for architecture, dependency injection, naming, documentation, data integrity, and unit test conventions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for backend changes with tests.

prompt_templates.title: Review a full pull request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this WooCommerce pull request across PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, tests, and interface copy. Group related findings and cite relevant standards.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for changes that span multiple parts of the repository.

prompt_templates.title: Assess architecture risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a detailed review of this WooCommerce change. Prioritize dependency injection violations, barrel self-imports, destructive state changes, and missing test coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for complex changes with higher architectural risk.

output_examples.input: A PHP change creates a managed service directly and adds a public method without required documentation.
output: Dependency injection: Resolve the managed class through the container. Cite the affected file and dependency injection standard.
Documentation: Add the required annotation and concise docblock. Cite the affected method and code entity standard.

output_examples.input: A settings screen labels its primary action as Save Changes.
output_examples.output: Sentence case: Change the label to Save changes. Cite the interface text location and sentence case standard.

output_examples.input: A TypeScript module imports its own package barrel, which re-exports that module.
output_examples.output: Barrel self-import: Replace the package barrel import with the direct module path to prevent a circular dependency.

best_practices: Provide the complete diff and enough surrounding code to verify each finding.
Load the referenced companion skills before reviewing detailed WooCommerce standards.
Validate each reported issue against the current repository context before changing code.
anti_patterns: Do not request a review without file paths or line context.
Do not treat the listed checks as a complete security or performance audit.
Do not apply suggested fixes without checking intentional public APIs and documented exceptions.

faq.question: What code does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews WooCommerce PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, tests, documentation, and interface copy against listed project conventions.

faq.question: Does it run automated tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides review instructions and does not run tests, linters, analyzers, or repository commands.

faq.question: Does it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. It includes a data integrity check, but it is not a complete security assessment.

faq.question: Why are companion skills required?
faq.answer: The companion skills contain the detailed WooCommerce standards, exceptions, and examples referenced by this review process.

faq.question: What should a finding include?
faq.answer: Each finding should identify the problem, file location, relevant standard, and a concise correction.

faq.question: Can it review interface text?
faq.answer: Yes. It flags title case in interface text and directs reviewers to the sentence case guidance.
